REDM.name: Redemption
REDM.definition: Transaction is a redemption of an investment fund.

SUBS.name: Subscription
SUBS.definition: Transaction is a subscription to an investment fund.

SSPL.name: Subscription Savings Plan
SSPL.definition: Transaction is a subscription for a savings plan, that is, money set aside by individuals in the framework of a structured plan for a special purpose, for example, retirement.

RWPL.name: Redemption Withdrawing Plan
RWPL.definition: Transaction is a withdrawal by individuals in the framework of a structured plan for investments made in the past.

TRIN.name: Transfer In
TRIN.definition: Transaction is an incoming credit to an account on the shareholders register, and is not linked to a shift in investment (subscription or switch), but to account management.

TOUT.name: Transfer Out
TOUT.definition: Transaction is a debit to an account on the shareholders register, and is not linked to a shift in investment (redemption or switch), but to account management.

SWII.name: Switch In
SWII.definition: Transaction is a subscription leg of a switch order execution.

SWIO.name: Switch Out
SWIO.definition: Transaction is a subscription leg of a switch order execution.

SUAA.name: Subscription Asset Allocation
SUAA.definition: Transaction is a subscription in an asset allocation plan that enables investors to allocate, by percentage a certain amount of cash into several sub-funds of a same umbrella structure.

REAA.name: Redemption Asset Allocation
REAA.definition: Transaction is a redemption in an asset allocation plan which enables investors to withdraw, by percentage a certain amount of cash from several sub-funds of a same umbrella structure.
